spots.name: Shrine of the Báb

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Shrine of the Báb is a structure on the slopes of Mount Carmel in Haifa, Israel, where the remains of the Báb, founder of the Bábí Faith and forerunner of Baháʼu'lláh in the Baháʼí Faith, are buried; it is considered to be the second holiest place on Earth for Baháʼís, after the Shrine of Baháʼu'lláh in Acre.

spots.name: Terraces
spots.summary: The Baháʼí Terraces, or the Hanging Gardens of Haifa, are garden terraces on Mount Carmel in Haifa, and one of the most popular tourist destinations in Israel. Completed in 2001, there are 19 terraces and more than 1,500 steps ascending the mountain.

spots.summary: Mount Carmel National Park is Israel's largest national park, extending over most of the Carmel mountain range, also known in Arabic as Mount Mar Elias containing over 10,000 hectares of pine, eucalyptus, and cypress forest.

spots.name: Mahmood Mosque

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Mahmood Mosque is a mosque on Mount Carmel in Kababir, in the Haifa district of Israel. It was built in the early 1930s and expanded by the Ahmadiyya Muslim community in the late 1970s and serves as the community's headquarters in the Middle East. It is known as the first Ahmadi mosque in the Arab world.

spots.name: Haifa City Museum

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Haifa City Museum was inaugurated in November 2000 as the historical City Museum. Its location, at the edge of Haifa's German Colony and near the historical part of the city, affords a view of a rich and complex urban fabric that reveals the historical diversity of the city's different populations.

spots.name: Eshkol Tower

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: At the top of Carmel, the campus was designed by Oscar Niemeyer, the architect of Brasilia and UN building in New York City. Newer buildings were added later. The top 30th floor of the Eshkol Tower provides an incredible view of almost the entire North of Israel. The campus is also home to the Hecht Museum with its rich archeology and art collections. Entry to both of these attraction is free.

spots.name: Haifa Museum of Art

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Haifa Museum of Art, established in 1951, is located in a historic building built in the 1930s in Wadi Nisnas, downtown Haifa. Ranking as Israel's third largest art museum, the museum focuses on Israeli and international contemporary art, and its collection includes 7,000 items, mostly of contemporary Israeli art.
